title: Sequence the M1 installation initialization and lifecycle implementation
goal: Create exact independently executable M1 child Plans in dependency order without combining Target trust-change, remote activation or release publication.
acceptanceCriteria: Six exact child Plan pairs cover runtime distribution, installed launchers, initialization, governance adoption, version lifecycle and storage retention.
Every child names exact code paths, tests, boundaries and stop/resume conditions.
The implementation order follows artifact and context dependencies while each sequential diff remains independently validatable.
No product code, Target, workflow, ruleset, release or remote state changes occur in this program checkpoint.
risks: A planning checkpoint could be mistaken for product implementation.
Cross-checkpoint dependencies could be hidden by combining remote or Target changes.
decisions: Use six sequential exact implementation checkpoints.
Represent predecessor checkpoints in review Markdown rather than recomposing already-committed paths.
Keep Target trust-change, remote activation and release publication separate.
validationCommands: Test-Json for all M1 implementation Plan JSON files
